united_earth_is_1: There are so many people who want to save our planet. Countless associations, organizations, companies and single people. But we don't know from each other.
united_earth_is_2: Why don't we show how many we are?
united_earth_is_3: We have to connect with each other to show how powerful our movement is. If we know how many we are, we could help people to change their feelings on climate change to courage and confidence. We could give people the power to start their own climate protection measures. Only together we can change the world and rescue the climate!
united_earth_is_4: Change the world by registering on our website! We are the majority!
united_earth_is_5: We warmly invite you to share this information with friends, partners and acquaintance.
united_earth_is_7: 200 pupils and 30 teachers at an Austrian school
united_earth_is_8: A subproject for attending the Austrian ecolabel
about_us_2: If we show how many we are, we could help people to change their feelings on climate change from desperation to courage and confidence. We could give people the power to start their own climate protection measures.
about_us_3: But above all: We would not feel alone and powerless anymore. It would bring us together. It would give us hope, strength, courage and confidence. We would feel connected all over the world - saving our planet and working for a better future.
about_us_4: Our goal is to give people courage, confidence and the power to start their own personal climate protection measures.
about_us_5: Attention: No fight because of different point of views – conviction, not coercion should be the basis for us to protect our planet.
about_us_6: 100 people, all speaking different languages, row together in a boat towards a waterfall. Almost everyone in the boat knows the dangerous situation. But almost everyone thinks to be the only one who knows about it. "What can I do?", everyone thinks. "To row in the other direction is useless!" And everyone indulges in the usual behaviour of the past. What would happen if suddenly everyone knew about each other - knew that everyone wanted to turn back and that they could communicate to each other?
about_us_7: The group would stop and turn the boat around.
about_us_8: United-Earth2025 – a subproject for attending the Austrian ecolabel.
about_us_9: The website and the connected social media pages are made by 200 pupils and teachers at an Austrian school.
about_us_10: The project was done as a subproject for attending the Austrian ecolabel. All items of the website were created as a school project.
about_us_11: We may follow different religions, differ in age and origin, but we all want to save our planet. All participants are volunteers.

ws_saving_earth_text: The state of our earth is deteriorating dramatically. Increasing droughts, floods and hurricanes, melting of the large ice sheets, rising sea levels, burning forests, poisoning of rivers and lakes, mountains of waste on land and in the sea and thousands of extinct animal and plant species. Our planet is at the limit of its performance. We want to save our planet before it's too late.
ws_peace_text: We are in favour of a peaceful coexistence of all peoples and peoples on our planet. We are in favour of mutual assistance and support. We are in favour of mutual acceptance and respectful treatment. We understand other people's needs.  We are in favour of a peaceful resolution of conflicts. We are in favour of alleviating suffering and pain. And we are in favour of a peaceful interaction between all peoples.
ws_forests_text: We are in favour of the protection of our forests and the protection of the sea. We are in favour of protecting our rivers and lakes. We are in favour of keeping our atmosphere clean and keeping the soil clean. And we recognize the connection between all living beings - humans, animals and plants. If our forests and the sea die, we too will die. Nothing exists independently.
ws_science_text: We are in favour of science and research that works for people and for our planet. In technology, in the natural sciences, in social sciences and law, in agriculture and forestry, medicine as well as in research and science in general. Only through the commitment and cooperation of all can we prevent irreversible, rapid warming above 2°C.
ws_greenhouse_text: There is hardly a CO2 budget left, which could be released into the atmosphere by us humans. However, global greenhouse gas emissions are increasing and the concentration of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere is increasing dramatically. The following greenhouse gases are mainly responsible for global warming. Carbon dioxide CO2, methane CH4 – factor 30, nitrous oxide N2O - factor 300, HFC factor up to 300 000)
ws_co2_h: Taking greenhouse gases out of the atmosphere
ws_co2_text: The concentration of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere is already so high that there will be a warming of approximately 1.5°C and beyond. It is important to prevent the occurrence of a domino effect (tipping points). Therefore, we need to get as much greenhouse gases out of the atmosphere as possible. By planting trees, creating green spaces and much more.
ws_animals_h: Protecting animals, forests and the sea
ws_animals_text: Every year, between 1 000 and 10 000 species die out. 75% of winged insects have become extinct in the last 25 years. In the sea, besides warming, acidification caused by the dissolved CO2 is one of the biggest problems. This leads to a catastrophic collapse of the entire life in the sea. If our forests, animals, plants and the sea die, then there won’t be a future for us human beings either.
ws_preparing_text: The rise in the global average temperature is currently around 1.4 ° C and will increase to 1.5 ° C by 2029. If all states, right down to every single one, practice intensive climate protection, we can limit the temperature to 2 ° C. The environmental disasters, the lack of food and water and the extinction of species will increase dramatically. All of humanity is facing challenges on an unprecedented scale.
ws_awareness_text: Unfortunately, far too few people know how bad things are for our planet. Aren’t we all in favour of a positive future with our parents, our children, our grandchildren, relatives and friends? Don’t we want to laugh with them, take them in our arms and feel joy? We just need to change in a positive direction. Let us share this message with courage, confidence, and love with other people.
ws_only_with_help: Only with your help we can make it
